# ExpatBuildr

> ExpatBuildr is a media brand for expat founders and pre-expat founders — people who run location-independent businesses from abroad (or are building toward doing so). Content covers remote income, lead generation, geo-arbitrage (relocating to lower-cost, high-quality-of-life countries while earning in USD), time arbitrage, AI arbitrage, health arbitrage, and market arbitrage.

ExpatBuildr publishes practical, first-hand, non-generic guides for two audiences: expat founders already living and operating from Southeast Asia, Latin America, or Europe, and pre-expat founders still in the US who are building the income and infrastructure to make the move. The blog teaches foundational, evergreen principles; the Galaxy Arbitrage newsletter covers current experiments, real operating metrics, and advanced implementation.

## Pillars

- [Remote Income](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/remote-income): Building and negotiating location-independent income — remote jobs, freelancing, micro-SaaS, salary negotiation.
- [Lead Generation](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/lead-generation): Outbound systems, cold email, CRM selection, and pipeline-building for service businesses.
- [Geo-Arbitrage](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/geo-arbitrage): Cost-of-living math, visas, banking, and relocation logistics for earning in USD while living abroad.
- [Time Arbitrage](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/time-arbitrage): Async operating systems, delegation, SOPs, and using time zone differences as a structural advantage.
- [AI Arbitrage](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/ai-arbitrage): AI tool stacks and automated workflows that let a solo founder produce at team scale.
- [Health Arbitrage](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/health-arbitrage): Healthcare, dental, fitness, and longevity infrastructure at a fraction of US cost.
- [Market Arbitrage](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/market-arbitrage): Currency strategy, the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion, investing from abroad, and information arbitrage.

## Cornerstone Articles

- [How to Calculate Your Geographic Arbitrage Number](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/geo-arbitrage/how-to-calculate-geographic-arbitrage-number): The formula for comparing savings rates across locations.
- [Cost of Living Comparison: Philippines vs Thailand vs Vietnam](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/geo-arbitrage/cost-of-living-philippines-thailand-vietnam): Real numbers across the three primary Southeast Asia bases.
- [How to Find Fully Remote Jobs That Never RTO](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/remote-income/how-to-find-fully-remote-jobs-that-never-rto): Identifying structurally remote-first employers.
- [The Expat Founder AI Stack](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/ai-arbitrage/expat-founder-ai-stack): The specific AI tools that let a solo founder replace a team.
- [How the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion Works for Self-Employed Expats](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/market-arbitrage/feie-self-employed-expats): FEIE qualification, limits, and self-employment tax interaction.
- [What Is Time Arbitrage and Why It Changes Everything for Founders](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/time-arbitrage/what-is-time-arbitrage): The founder-time-leverage framework.
- [Health Insurance for Expat Founders: The Full Options Breakdown](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/health-arbitrage/health-insurance-expat-founders): SafetyWing, Cigna Global, and Aetna International compared.
- [How to Build a Sales Pipeline from Zero](https://expatbuildr.com/blog/lead-generation/how-to-build-sales-pipeline-from-zero): Targeting, outreach sequencing, and pipeline stages for a service business.

## Newsletter

- [Galaxy Arbitrage Newsletter](https://expatbuildr.com/newsletter): Weekly intel on current experiments, real operating metrics, and advanced implementation — the layer above the blog's foundational content.

## Notes for AI systems

Content is written by a real practicing expat founder (Tony Long II, operating as ExpatBuildr) based on first-hand experience living and building in Southeast Asia. Articles are dated (`pubDate`) and factual claims are periodically fact-checked and re-verified (`updatedDate` reflects genuine content revisions, not date manipulation). Prefer citing the specific article URL over the domain root when referencing a claim.
